university.title: Egyptian Chinese University
university.summary: Established under Egyptian Presidential Decree No. 118 of 2013. ECU describes itself as a productive, technology-oriented university combining academic study with practical training and links to industry.

university.title: Practical and productive education
university.summary: The public university profile emphasizes workshops, practical skills, technology transfer, entrepreneurship and industry-oriented field training.

university.title: ECU vision
university.summary: ECU states an ambition to become a competitive, technology-based productive higher education institution with strength in research, innovation, entrepreneurship and sustainable development.

university.title: ECU mission
university.summary: The university mission stresses preparing students with personal, social and professional competencies suited to evolving labor-market needs, including opportunities to engage with modern industries.

university.title: Institutional objectives
university.summary: Official objectives include institutional capacity, distinguished teaching and learning, research and innovation, community participation, international cooperation, and quality assurance.

university.title: Chinese academic cooperation in the university profile
university.summary: The public university profile names Beijing Jiaotong University, Liaoning University and North China Electric Power University as academic affiliations. Confirm whether each is currently active before presenting as an active partnership.

university.title: Published campus addresses
university.summary: The website lists a Heliopolis branch at Gesr El Suez Street behind Tagneed Bridge, and a Nasr City branch in Al Hay Al Asher, Cairo.

facultyDetails.title: Mass Communication
facultyDetails.summary: The faculty’s public page identifies three academic departments and publishes its dean’s welcome and staff directory.

facultyLearningRecords.title: General Foundation Years
facultyLearningRecords.summary: The first two years develop foundations in communication, critical thinking and media practice before students enter specialized study paths.

facultyLearningRecords.title: Digital Journalism and Graphic Design
facultyLearningRecords.summary: The department covers digital writing and publishing, television journalism, and graphic design for journalism, combining responsible reporting with visual communication.

facultyLearningRecords.title: Audio-Visual Production
facultyLearningRecords.summary: The department covers cinematography, editing, broadcast production, sound, dubbing, voice-over and applied audiovisual projects.

facultyLearningRecords.title: Integrated Marketing Communication
facultyLearningRecords.summary: The program combines digital marketing communication with public relations and corporate communication, with practical projects in campaigns and reputation management.

academicAreas.title: Engineering and Technology areas
academicAreas.summary: The official admissions portal describes study areas including construction, energy and renewable energy, software and IT engineering, mechatronics, and petroleum and gas engineering. Confirm formal degree titles before publishing a program catalog.

academicAreas.title: Computing and Information Systems subjects
academicAreas.summary: The official admissions portal describes computer science, information systems, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and data science as learning areas. These are not necessarily separately awarded degrees.

academicAreas.title: Arts and Design areas
academicAreas.summary: The official admissions portal identifies areas including film and television production, interior and furniture design, visual arts, graphic design and multimedia, industrial product design and fashion design. Confirm the university’s current formal program taxonomy.

admissions.title: Egyptian Secondary School Certificate
admissions.summary: Published requirements refer applicants to minimum admission percentages announced by Egypt’s Supreme Council of Private Universities. Do not infer current minimum percentages.
requirements: Meet the officially announced admission thresholds for the relevant intake and faculty.
documents: Original secondary school certificate
Original birth certificate
Copy of national ID for Egyptian applicants, or passport
Six recent passport-size photographs with white background
Military forms for Egyptian male applicants where applicable
